messages:
Alyssa: Heads up — CI started failing on the sampleapp publish flow after today's regen. Looks like a regen diff bumped a minor in CHANGELOG and auth/retry parity tests now fail in the TS SDK.
Alyssa: Short repro log pasted below. Not sure if it's typegen or openapi ordering.
```
> yarn typegen:regen --ci
Regenerating API types...
Writing types for /client v2
+ CHANGELOG.md updated: 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0
- typegen: reordered optional params in generateRequest(endpoint, options?) => generateRequest(options?, endpoint)
+ docs: added new example for batchEmbeddings
```
Matt: ugh. Is that the same openapi property ordering thing we saw last week?
Jamie: That ordering change came from #4576 — we normalized optional params to the schema's parameter array. It slipped through because the regen diffs were auto-accepted.
Sophie: The problem is the changelog bump. regen tooling should never auto-bump a minor unless there's a user-visible API change. This looks like churn-only.
Chris: Repro steps I ran locally: `yarn regen && yarn test:ci packages/sdk-ts --filter auth-retry` — test fails immediately.
Chris: Failing test snippet:
```
● auth-retry.spec.ts › retries on transient 401

expect(received).toEqual(expected) // deep equality

Expected: true
Received: false
at Object.<anonymous> (packages/sdk-ts/test/auth-retry.spec.ts:34:12)
```
Matt: Could the param reorder change alter runtime callsites in JS consumers? TS is structural but runtime arg order matters for some helper overloads.
Jamie: Yeah — generateRequest had a runtime overload where we checked `typeof endpoint === 'string'` vs `typeof options === 'object'`. Swapped params broke that guard.
Sophie: Two things we should do: 1) revert the functional change so it's just a type reorder (no runtime swap), 2) add a CI gate that disallows changelog semver bumps caused only by reformatting/type-only changes.
Alyssa: Agreed. Also we need to avoid the auto minor-bump in regen. Can we make regen detect only list of docs vs API surface changes?
Jamie: I can push a revert PR for the runtime swap (will target patch). For regen: I'll add a heuristic to the regen script: if only param order in types changes and runtime JS unchanged, mark as patch and don't bump minor.
Chris: For immediate unblocking: revert + force-publish patch of packages/sdk-ts@1.2.1 and rerun the publish CI.
devex-bot: Created issue DEVEX-2345: "regen: prevent minor bump for type-only diffs" and linked PR 4622 as a follow-up.
ci-bot: Rerun requested for build #4821 (queued).
Matt: We should also add a small unit test in auth-retry to catch this kind of overload-guard regression.
Sophie: Good call. Add a test asserting helper accepts (endpoint, options) and (options, endpoint) shapes — expecting only the documented form to work.
Alyssa: Thanks — assigning the revert + tests to @Jamie, will follow up on the regen heuristic with @Matt. If CI passes after revert we'll roll out patch and then plan a proper minor with explicit API docs for any breaking behavior. :thumbsup:
Jamie: On it, will open the revert PR in ~30m.
Alyssa: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread for status updates.
